- `get_analytics_aggregator()` — Return the process-wide analytics aggregator singleton.

- **class `AnalyticsConfig`** — Complete analytics configuration derived from ``config.yaml``.

Shared API key store — avoids circular imports between server.py and routes.

- `set_api_key(key: str)` — Store the API key at startup.

## `core.api.routes.actions`

REST endpoints for ``data/actions.mca`` and the gift catalog.

- `async get_actions()` — Return all parsed action triggers (``GET /actions``).
- `async update_actions(body: ActionsUpdateRequest)` — Validate, serialise and persist structured triggers (``PUT /actions``).
- `async get_actions_raw()` — Return raw ``.mca`` content plus diagnostics (``GET /actions/raw``).
- `async update_actions_raw(body: RawActionsUpdateRequest)` — Validate and persist raw ``.mca`` content (``PUT /actions/raw``).
- `async validate_actions()` — Validate the stored ``.mca`` file (``GET /actions/validate``).
- `async validate_actions_content(body: RawActionsUpdateRequest)` — Validate the supplied ``.mca`` content (``POST /actions/validate``).
- `async validate_triggers_structured(body: ActionsUpdateRequest)` — Validate structured triggers without saving (``POST /actions/validate-triggers``).
- `async get_gifts()` — Return the gift catalog enriched with image URLs (``GET /gifts``).
- `sync_gifts_catalog(body: GiftSyncRequest | None=None)` — Fetch and persist an updated gift catalog (``POST /gifts/sync``).
- `async get_registered_scripts()` — List script actions registered by hooks (``GET /actions/scripts``).

## `core.api.routes.analytics`

All-time analytics leaderboard endpoints.

- `async get_analytics_leaderboard(limit: int=Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description='Entries per leaderboard'))` — Return all-time gifters, likers, commenters and gift leaderboards.

## `core.api.routes.backups`

REST endpoints for creating, listing and restoring configuration/data backups.

- `async list_backups()` — List all backup categories with their files, newest first.
- `async restore_backup(body: BackupRestoreRequest)` — Restore a backup file back to its target (with a pre-restore snapshot).
- `async create_backups(body: BackupCreateRequest)` — Create backups of the requested targets immediately.

## `core.api.routes.builtins`

Built-in script action endpoints.

- `async get_builtins()` — List all built-in script actions and their metadata.
- `async get_builtin_config(name: str)` — Return the stored configuration for one built-in action.
- `async get_builtin_config_schema(name: str)` — Return the configuration schema declared by a built-in action.
- `async put_builtin_config(name: str, body: dict)` — Replace the configuration of a built-in action.

## `core.api.routes.chatbot`

Chatbot configuration, session and status endpoints.

- `async get_chatbot_config()` — Return the chatbot config; defaults when no file exists yet.
- `async update_chatbot_config(body: ChatbotConfigUpdateRequest)` — Persist the chatbot config and ask the bridge to hot-reload it.
- `async get_chatbot_session()` — Secret-free info about the stored TikTok session credentials.
- `async update_chatbot_session(body: ChatbotSessionUpdateRequest)` — Encrypt and store new session credentials (manual login, CHATBOT.md §4).
- `async delete_chatbot_session()` — Remove stored session credentials.
- `async get_chatbot_status()` — Last known chatbot status reported by the bridge (None if stale).

## `core.api.routes.events`

Event ingestion and SSE streaming endpoints used by the bridge and GUI.

- `async inject_event(body: dict, x_t2m_source: str | None=Header(default=None, alias=BRIDGE_SOURCE_HEADER))` — Inject an event into the bus from any component.
- `async ingest_event(body: dict, x_t2m_source: str | None=Header(default=None, alias=BRIDGE_SOURCE_HEADER))` — Generic structured inbound for extensions and external systems.

## `core.api.routes.health`

Health and status endpoints reporting API, bridge and TikTok connection state.

- `async health()` — Return the minimal liveness response with API and tool versions.
- `async status()` — Return aggregated runtime status for plugins, TikTok and the bridge.
- `async health_extended()` — Extended health check with subsystem status.

## `core.api.routes.hooks`

Hook management API endpoints.

- `async list_hook_widgets()` — List all registered dashboard widgets (title only, no HTML).
- `async register_hook_widget(name: str, body: dict)` — Register/replace a hook's dashboard widget.
- `async delete_hook_widget(name: str)` — Remove a hook's widget (called when the hook is disabled/deleted).
- `async get_hook_widget(name: str)` — Return a hook's widget as ``{"name", "title", "html"}``.
- `async get_hook_widget_page(name: str)` — Serve a hook's widget as a standalone HTML document (iframe target).
- `async list_hooks()` — List all registered hooks with their status.
- `async discover_hooks()` — Scan hook directories and register any new hooks.
- `async check_hook_updates()` — Check all registered hooks for available updates.
- `async install_hook_updates()` — Install all pending standalone hook updates.
- `async get_hook(name: str)` — Get details for a single hook.
- `async enable_hook(name: str)` — Enable a hook. Takes effect immediately via runtime reload.
- `async disable_hook(name: str)` — Disable a hook. Takes effect immediately via runtime reload.
- `async get_hook_config(name: str)` — Get the per-hook config for a named hook.
- `async update_hook_config(name: str, body: dict)` — Update the per-hook config for a named hook.
- `async get_hook_config_schema(name: str)` — Get the config schema for a hook (from hook.json).

## `core.api.routes.logs`

Log viewing and crash report endpoints.

- `async logs_stream()` — Server-Sent Events stream of unified log entries.
- `async list_crash_reports()` — List all crash report files with metadata.
- `async get_crash_report(filename: str)` — Return a single crash report as JSON.

## `core.api.routes.mc_plugins`

REST endpoints for managing server-side Minecraft plugins per server instance.

- **class `McPluginInfo`** — Metadata for one server-side Minecraft plugin file.
- **class `McPluginsListResponse`** — Response listing the plugins installed for an instance.
- **class `McPluginActionResponse`** — Response for enabling or disabling a server-side plugin.
- **class `McPluginDeleteResponse`** — Response for deleting a server-side plugin.
- **class `McPluginUploadResponse`** — Response for uploading a server-side plugin jar.
- `async list_mc_plugins(instance_id: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Server instance ID')])` — List installed plugins for a server instance (``GET .../mc-plugins``).
- `async enable_mc_plugin(instance_id: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Server instance ID')], plugin_name: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Plugin name')])` — Enable a plugin by removing its ``.disabled`` suffix.
- `async disable_mc_plugin(instance_id: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Server instance ID')], plugin_name: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Plugin name')])` — Disable a plugin by appending the ``.disabled`` suffix.
- `async delete_mc_plugin(instance_id: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Server instance ID')], plugin_name: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Plugin name')])` — Delete a plugin jar (or its disabled variant) from an instance.
- `async upload_mc_plugin(instance_id: Annotated[str, PathParam(description='Server instance ID')], file: Annotated[UploadFile, File(description='Plugin .jar file')])` — Stream an uploaded ``.jar`` into the instance's plugins directory.

## `core.api.routes.plugins`

Plugin registration & management endpoints.

- `async register_plugin(body: PluginRegisterRequest)` — Register or update a plugin in the central registry.
- `async list_plugins()` — Return every registered plugin, plus filesystem-discovered ones.
- `async check_plugin_updates()` — Check all registered plugins for available updates.
- `async install_plugin_updates()` — Install all pending plugin updates immediately.
- `async discover_plugins()` — Scan filesystem manifests and merge with registry state.
- `async list_plugin_queries()` — List every plugin's declared query names discovery.
- `async enable_plugin(name: str)` — Enable a plugin by name and signal runtime start.
- `async disable_plugin(name: str)` — Disable a plugin by name and signal runtime stop.
- `async get_plugin(name: str)` — Return a single plugin by name.
- `async update_plugin(name: str, body: PluginUpdateRequest)` — Partially update a plugin's properties (e.g. enable/disable, health).
- `async restart_plugin(name: str)` — Restart a plugin process by writing stop/start signals for start.py.
- `async unregister_plugin(name: str)` — Remove a plugin from the registry, stop its process, and clean up signals.

## `core.api.routes.rcon`

RCON console endpoints for direct command execution and log streaming.

- **class `CommandRequest`** — Request body containing one RCON command.
- **class `CommandResponse`** — Response containing the RCON command output.
- **class `StatusResponse`** — Response describing the current RCON connection state.
- `async get_status()` — Return the current RCON connection state (``GET /rcon/status``).
- `async connect()` — Connect using the configured RCON settings (``POST /rcon/connect``).
- `async disconnect()` — Disconnect RCON and stop console capture for the default instance.
- `async send_command(req: CommandRequest)` — Execute a command when the HTTP command API is enabled (``POST /rcon/command``).

Runtime reload endpoint.

## `core.api.routes.revenue`

Revenue log endpoints (daily gift revenue viewer).

- `async get_revenue()` — Return all revenue log entries plus metadata about the log file.
- `async get_revenue_summary(start: str | None=Query(None, description='Inclusive start date YYYY-MM-DD'), end: str | None=Query(None, description='Inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD'))` — Return summary statistics over the revenue log, optionally date-filtered.

## `core.api.routes.server_lifecycle`

Endpoints that start, stop and monitor the supervised Minecraft server process.

- `async auto_start_mc_instances()` — Start all MC server instances that have ``auto_start: True``.
- `async java_status(install_id: str | None=None)` — Return Java detection and installation status (``GET /server/java/status``).

- `get_active_app_dir()` — Return the active versioned ``app-<ver>/`` directory, or ``None``.
- `get_data_home_base()` — Return the base directory that holds user data (P3a §3).
- `get_config_file()` — Return the user config file (config/config.yaml, data-home aware).
- `get_chatbot_config_file()` — Return the chatbot's own config file (config/chatbot.yaml).
- `get_chatbot_session_file()` — Return the encrypted chatbot session store (data/chatbot_session.json).
- `get_runtime_dir()` — Return the runtime IPC directory (core/runtime, data-home aware).
- `get_plugin_data_dir()` — Return the namespaced per-plugin/hook storage directory.
- `get_plugin_dir()` — Return the directory of the currently loaded plugin or hook entry point.
- `get_plugin_config_file()` — Return the plugin-local ``config.yaml`` next to the current entry point.
- `get_plugins_dir()` — Return the resolved plugins directory.
- `get_versions_dir()` — Return the resolved versions directory (template repository).
- `get_servers_dir()` — Return the resolved server instances directory (server/<instance>/).

## `core.plugin_config`

Plugin-local configuration loader, schema parser, and validator.

- `discover_plugins_dir()` — Return the resolved plugins directory (dev or release layout).
- `load_plugin_manifest(plugin_dir: Path)` — Read ``plugin.json`` from the given plugin directory.
- `get_plugin_config_path(plugin_dir: Path)` — Return the expected ``config.yaml`` path inside a plugin directory.
- `load_plugin_config(plugin_dir: Path, apply_defaults: bool=True, *, manifest_override: dict | None=None)` — Load a plugin's local ``config.yaml``.
- `save_plugin_config(plugin_dir: Path, data: dict, backup: bool=True)` — Write *data* to the plugin's ``config.yaml`` atomically.
- `validate_plugin_config(data: dict, schema: dict | None)` — Validate *data* against the given schema.
- `load_all_plugin_configs()` — Discover all plugins and load their local configs.

## `core.port_scanner`

Port conflict detection and auto-resolution on startup.

- **class `PortPolicy`** — Policy controlling how occupied ports are handled.
- **class `PortCheckResult`** — Outcome of checking one configured bind port.
- `is_port_in_use(host: str, port: int)` — Check if *port* is already bound on *host*.
- `find_available_port(host: str, preferred: int, max_offset: int)` — Return the first available port starting at *preferred*.
- `scan_bind_ports(host: str, policy: PortPolicy, config: dict[str, Any] | None=None, bind_ports: list[dict[str, Any]] | None=None)` — Check every bind port and optionally resolve conflicts.
- `build_resolved_map(results: list[PortCheckResult])` — Build ``{key: resolved_port}`` from scan results.
- `write_runtime_file(resolved: dict[str, int], runtime_dir: Path)` — Write resolved ports to ``core/runtime/ports_resolved.json``.
- `clear_runtime_file(runtime_dir: Path)` — Remove the resolved ports file (session-only cleanup).
- `get_resolved_port(key: str, default: int, runtime_dir: Path | None=None)` — Read a resolved port from runtime file or env var, falling back to *default*.
- `ports_to_env(resolved: dict[str, int])` — Convert resolved port map to environment variable dict.
- `persist_to_config(resolved: dict[str, int], config_path: Path, bind_ports: list[dict[str, Any]] | None=None)` — Write resolved port values back to the user config file.

Runtime signal files (``core/runtime/``) — supervisor IPC.

- `write_plugin_signal(plugin_name: str, action: str)` — Write a plugin lifecycle signal file for the supervisor watcher.
- `clean_plugin_signals(plugin_name: str)` — Remove all runtime signal files for a plugin.

Plugin sandboxing and resource limits.

## `core.secure_storage`

Encrypted local storage for sensitive configuration values.

- **class `SecureStorage`** — Encrypt and decrypt small strings (e.g. API secrets, tokens).

## `core.server_jar`

PaperMC server.jar download and copy helpers.

- **class `ServerJarError`** — Raised when a server.jar cannot be obtained (download/copy/network).
- `is_supported_version(version: str)` — Whether *version* is accepted by the PaperMC auto-download (stable, >=1.13).
- `resolve_download_url(version: str)` — Return the best stable build's download URL for *version*.
- `ensure_version_jar(version: str)` — Ensure ``versions/<version>/server.jar`` exists, downloading it if needed.
- `ensure_instance_jar(instance_id: str, version: str)` — Ensure ``server/<instance_id>/server.jar`` exists for *version*.
- `copy_version_jar_to_instances(version: str)` — Copy ``versions/<version>/server.jar`` into every instance that is missing it (but expects that version). Returns the number of copies made.

## `core.shutdown`

Centralized shutdown controller for TikTok2Mc.

- **class `ShutdownReason`** — Why the shutdown was requested.
- **class `ShutdownState`** — Lifecycle states of the shutdown process.
- **class `ShutdownRequest`** — Immutable record of a single shutdown request.
- **class `ShutdownController`** — Central coordinator for all shutdown requests.
- `get_shutdown_controller()` — Return the global ShutdownController, creating it on first call.
- `reset_shutdown_controller()` — Reset the singleton (for testing only).

## `core.theme`

Theme default merging for overlays and other theme-aware consumers.

- `load_plugin_theme(plugin_cfg: dict, theme_key: str)` — Return merged theme colors for an overlay consumer.
- `sanitize_css_key(key: str)` — Keep only characters that are safe inside a CSS custom-property name.
- `sanitize_css_value(value: str)` — Strip characters that could break out of a CSS declaration block.
- `theme_css(colors: dict)` — Render ``colors`` as CSS custom properties inside a ``:root`` block.

## `core.tiktok_chatbot`

TikTok chatbot — sends messages to the connected TikTok live room.

- **class `ChatbotReply`** — One auto-reply rule — what the bot posts in a given situation.
- **class `ChatbotConfig`** — Typed view of ``config/chatbot.yaml`` with safe defaults.
- **class `TikTokChatbot`** — Event-driven chat sender with spam protection.
- `ctx_main_loop()` — Return the running main loop, or None outside asyncio context.
- `get_chatbot(status_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], None] | None=None)` — Return the process-wide bot instance.

``TriggerEngine``: validates and dispatches test triggers to the bridge.

- **class `TriggerEngine`** — Shared trigger execution engine.

## `core.trigger_engine.models`

Dataclasses and enums shared by the trigger engine.

- **class `ExecutionStatus`** — Outcome of a trigger execution.
- **class `ValidationError`** — A single validation problem found in trigger input.
- **class `TriggerResult`** — Structured result from a single trigger execution.
- **class `TriggerDefinition`** — Metadata for a registered trigger type.
- **class `EngineConfig`** — Configuration for the TriggerEngine.

Input validation rules for trigger payloads.

## `core.update_engine.launch_layout`

Launcher-side layout resolution (P3a §7).

- `resolve_app_base(base_dir: Path, root_dir: Path)` — Return ``(app_base, migrated)`` for the launcher.
- `swap_pending_launcher_binaries(root_dir: Path, suffix: str)` — Install queued launcher binaries (``*_new``) at the next boot.
- `run_first_start_config_hook(root_dir: Path)` — Migrate user config once per new tool version (launcher boot).

## `core.update_engine.manifest`

Signed release manifests for the versioned update architecture.

- **class `ManifestError`** — Raised when manifest data is structurally invalid.
- **class `ManifestFile`** — One file entry of a release manifest.
- **class `Manifest`** — A validated release manifest.
- `serialize_manifest(manifest: Manifest)` — Serialize *manifest* deterministically to the bytes that get signed.
- `parse_manifest_bytes(raw: bytes)` — Parse and validate raw manifest bytes.
- `generate_manifest(app_dir: Path, *, tool_version: str, config_version_expected: str, updater_version: str='', min_start_version: str='', channel: str='stable', created_utc: str='', prefix: str | None=None)` — Generate a manifest covering all files under *app_dir*.
- `sign_manifest_bytes(raw: bytes, private_key: Ed25519PrivateKey)` — Return the detached Ed25519 signature over the exact manifest bytes.
- `write_manifest(output_dir: Path, manifest: Manifest, private_key: Ed25519PrivateKey)` — Write ``manifest.json`` and its detached signature under *output_dir*.
- `verify_signature(raw: bytes, signature: bytes, public_key: Ed25519PublicKey)` — Check the detached signature of manifest bytes against *public_key*.
- `load_fs_signature(manifest_path: Path)` — Read the detached signature file belonging to *manifest_path*.
- `verify_files(root: Path, manifest: Manifest)` — Verify every manifest file under *root*.

## `core.update_engine.migration`

One-time migration of legacy flat layouts into versioned app dirs (P3a §8).

- **class `MigrationResult`** — Outcome of :func:`migrate_install`.
- `extract_version(text: str | None)` — Extract the first ``x.y(.z)`` version substring, or ``0.0.0``.
- `parse_version_txt(path: Path)` — Parse a release ``version.txt`` into ``{"tool": .., "updater": ..}``.
- `read_state()` — Read the migration journal, or ``None`` when absent/corrupt.
- `is_legacy_install(root: Path)` — True when *root* still has flat program content to migrate.
- `migrate_install(root: Path, *, tool_version: str | None=None)` — Migrate a legacy flat install under *root* into the versioned layout.

## `core.update_engine.pointer`

``current.json`` pointer management for versioned app updates.

- **class `PointerError`** — Raised when pointer data is structurally invalid for writing.
- **class `AppPointer`** — Content of one ``current.json`` pointer file.
- `pointer_path(root: Path)` — Return the filesystem path of the pointer file under *root*.
- `scan_app_dirs(root: Path)` — Return all ``app-<version>`` directories under *root*, oldest first.
- `read_pointer(root: Path)` — Read and validate the pointer under *root*.
- `write_pointer(root: Path, pointer: AppPointer)` — Atomically write *pointer* under *root* and return the final path.
- `resolve_active_app_dir(root: Path)` — Resolve the active versioned app directory under *root*.
- `prune_versions(root: Path, active_dir_name: str, previous_dir_name: str | None=None)` — Delete all ``app-<version>`` dirs except *active* and *previous*.

Small shared helpers for config-version normalisation and value coercion.

## `core.validation_framework`

Validation framework for TikTok2Mc.

- **class `ValidationResult`** — Result of a single validation step.
- **class `ValidationSuite`** — A collection of related validation steps.
- **class `TimeoutResult`** — Result of a timed operation.
- `async run_with_timeout(coro, timeout: float, label: str='operation')` — Run an async operation with a timeout.
- `run_with_timeout_sync(func, timeout: float, label: str='operation')` — Run a synchronous operation with a timeout via threading.
- `validate_config_exists(config_path: Path)` — Validate that the main config file exists and is readable.
- `validate_directory(path: Path, name: str, create: bool=False)` — Validate that a directory exists and is accessible.
- `validate_file(path: Path, name: str)` — Validate that a file exists.
- `validate_port_free(host: str, port: int, description: str)` — Validate that a port is free to bind.
- `validate_executable(path: Path, name: str)` — Validate that an executable exists and is runnable.
- `run_startup_validation(config_path: Path | None=None, required_dirs: list[tuple[Path, str, bool]] | None=None, required_files: list[tuple[Path, str]] | None=None, required_ports: list[tuple[str, int, str]] | None=None, required_executables: list[tuple[Path, str]] | None=None)` — Run a comprehensive startup validation suite.
- `validate_shutdown(*, threads_to_check: list[threading.Thread] | None=None, tasks_to_check: list[asyncio.Task] | None=None, timeout: float=10.0)` — Run shutdown validation to ensure clean termination.
- `validate_runtime(health_monitor=None, components: list[str] | None=None, heartbeat_timeout: float=60.0)` — Run runtime validation checks.
- `validate_config_schema(data: Any, path: str='')` — Validate *data* against the config schema.

- `print_diagnostics(diags: list[Diagnostic])` — Log all diagnostics in a human-readable format (1-based line numbers).
- `validate_text(text: str)` — Validate trigger/command definition text and return diagnostics.
- `validate_file(file_path: str | Path, raise_on_error: bool=True)` — Read and validate a trigger/command file.

## `core.yaml_utils`

ruamel.yaml helpers for comment-preserving load/save and deep merges.

- `create_yaml_rt()` — Create a ruamel.yaml round-trip parser with project conventions.
- `load_yaml(path: Path)` — Load a YAML file with round-trip preservation (comments, ordering, formatting).
- `save_yaml(path: Path, data: Any, backup: bool=False)` — Write *data* to *path* atomically, preserving ruamel.yaml metadata.
- `deep_update_rt(base: Any, overlay: Any)` — Recursively merge *overlay* into *base* in-place.
